Bought some $DOGE here. Either it dies here or it goes up. Risk reward seems worth a punt

My thesis for $SHIB and $DOGE is simple 

Etoro
Coinbase
Crypto dot com
Robinhood (soon for SHIB) 

Are all competing and spending marketing dollars to pump these bags

Do your coins have millions of dollars of marketing budget assigned to shilling them?

What can the rest of crypto learn from the success of $DOGE and $SHIB?

Marketing matters.

These dog coins are supported by millions of dollars in ad spend by retail crypto platforms.

DeFi treasuries with billions of dollars doing nothing need to start spending some cash.

I think there's a sweet spot somewhere between $DOGE and $SHIB in terms of unit bias and tokenomics where you can own enough coins that the 'what if it was $1' dream would be life changing money but that target is not so far off that you lose motivation and momentum.
